correctness.rationale: All quantifiers are explicit: a>=2, m>=5, regular three-form sequence, gcd of the four maximal minors equal to 1, and coefficient degrees r from 0 through (m-2)a. The Koszul syzygy theorem on a regular sequence forces every intermediary coefficient to vanish below degree (m-1)a; primitive determinantal kernel then gives the exact graded module. Generic first-jet incidence supplies coprimality and excludes off-base singularities, and Bertini, Bezout, and local coordinates give the exact isolated singularities and Tjurina numbers. An exact concrete checker reproduces the polynomial syzygy, transverse base and degree-by-degree dimensions; it is not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The motivated unknown is the exact initial graded Jacobian-syzygy module, not an artificial numerical experiment: it refines the least-degree invariant for an infinite and geometrically controlled class of singular projective surfaces. The explicit binomial Hilbert-function segment and unique minimal generator supply data not recoverable from general singular-scheme degree or Arnold-exponent inequalities alone. The natural objects are Fermat pullbacks by a three-form complete intersection, and the cutoff is exactly the largest range forced by low-degree Koszul rigidity; no unsupported downstream theorem is asserted.
